description: Capability for the React SPA webview. Matches on `webviews` only (not `windows`) so the grant is narrowed to webviews literally labeled 'main' — any child webview added to the main window with a different label (e.g. the sniffer) doesn't inherit the broad core:default surface. Per Tauri 2 ACL semantics, `windows` and `webviews` match independently (OR), so listing `windows: ['main']` here would have broadened the grant to every webview inside the main window regardless of label.
